Rhea (CS): Heads-up: OrionHealth hit 79% of monthly credits after enabling nightly patient-note summarization. QBR in 10 days. We should prepare a cost-first remediation + narrative.
Tom (AE): Is the spike from summarization frequency or longer contexts?
Rhea (CS): Mostly frequency. They run summaries after every save (approx 1.2M saves/day). Nightly bulk re-summarize also runs.
Inez (Solutions Eng): Quick wins: 1) change summaries to "on-save light" + nightly consolidated re-summary, 2) batch nightly jobs (batch_size=400), 3) introduce dedupe on identical notes.
SpendGuardBot: alert: account_usage.orionhealth > 75% monthly_credits (triggered at 3123456890).
Ariel (Finance): If they cross 90% pre-renewal this materially affects discount leverage. Need a 3-scenario spend projection for the QBR.
Tom (AE): Customer wants no UX regressions. Can we propose an opt-in "consolidated nightly" toggle and a small temporary soft cap as a safety net?
Inez (Solutions Eng): Yes. Proposed opt-in policy for Console:
```yaml
name: orion-consolidated-nightly
scope: org:orionhealth
action: enable_consolidated_nightly_summaries
batch_size: 400
opt_in: true
```
Rhea (CS): I'll schedule a runbook session with their platform team tomorrow 10am ET to walk batching and dedupe. Will capture blocker notes.
ProductEchoBot: feedback: OrionHealth requested per-summary cost estimates in Console. Logged as FR-8123.
Ariel (Finance): For the QBR scenarios use conservative savings: (A) no changes, (B) batching + consolidated nightly = ~30% savings, (C) + dedupe + smaller summary model = ~42% savings. I'll build the table.
Tom (AE): I'll draft the one-pager: root cause, remediation steps taken, projected spend table, recommended commit ask and optional credit to smooth the renewal.
Inez (Solutions Eng): Small technical note: dedupe pass can be CPU intensive initially; recommend rolling dedupe and staging plan to avoid infra pain.
Rhea (CS): Action items: Tom - one-pager; Rhea - runbook & feedback capture; Inez - PR for batching + dedupe guidance; Ariel - spend scenarios and credit model.
Tom (AE): I'll ask exec sponsor to join the QBR. Let's keep the one-pager to one page + appendix with graphs.
SpendGuardBot: note: ticket CS-10122 created to track OrionHealth summaries remediation.
Rhea (CS): I'll post the runbook notes + projected graphs here after the enablement call. Thanks team :thumbsup:
